sloka: यथा ऽ शनिरवेभ्यस्तु जायते ऽथ प्रतिश्रुतिः ।तथा तयोर्गदापोथैर्दिशः सर्वाः प्रतिश्रुताः ।। ७.३२.५५ ॥
transliteration: yathā ' śaniravebhyastu jāyate 'tha pratiśrutiḥ ।tathā tayorgadāpothairdiśaḥ sarvāḥ pratiśrutāḥ ।। 7.32.55 ॥

translations.english: Just as an echo arises from the sounds of thunder, similarly, all directions reverberated with the impacts of their maces.
